tools.name: vehicle-transport_vin-check-digit-validate
tools.description: Validate the structure and 9th-position check digit of a 17-character VIN and read model-year code candidates from 49 CFR Part 565. Pure computation; no network. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/vin-check-digit-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_vin-decode
tools.description: Decode a VIN to make, model, year, body, engine and plant fields from the vendored NHTSA vPIC standalone database. No live vPIC API call. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/vin-decode. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_nhtsa-recall-by-vin
tools.description: List NHTSA safety recall campaigns filed since 2010 for a VIN (decoded locally) or make/model/year from the vendored ODI flat file. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/nhtsa-recall-by-vin. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_nhtsa-safety-ratings
tools.description: Return NHTSA Safercar 5-Star Safety Ratings and listed safety equipment for a make, model and model year from the vendored Safercar file. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/nhtsa-safety-ratings. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_epa-fuel-economy-lookup
tools.description: Return EPA fuel-economy, CO2 and annual fuel-cost figures (and EV range/consumption) from the vendored fueleconomy.gov vehicle file. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/epa-fuel-economy-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_uk-ved-rate-lookup
tools.description: Compute UK Vehicle Excise Duty for cars, vans, motorcycles and tricycles for the rate year 1 April 2026 – 31 March 2027 from GOV.UK rate tables in code. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/vehicle-transport/uk-ved-rate-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: vehicle-transport_bts-ontime-lookup
tools.description: Return official on-time, cancellation and diversion counts for a US carrier, airport or route from vendored BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance aggregates (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "vehicle-transport" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vehicle-transport_vin-check-digit-validate, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-recall-by-vin · Private data: vehicle-transport_vin-decode, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-recall-by-vin, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-safety-ratings, vehicle-transport_epa-fuel-economy-lookup · Public sink: vehicle-transport_vin-check-digit-validate, vehicle-transport_vin-decode, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-recall-by-vin, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-safety-ratings, vehicle-transport_epa-fuel-economy-lookup, vehicle-transport_uk-ved-rate-lookup, vehicle-transport_bts-ontime-lookup · Destructive: vehicle-transport_vin-check-digit-validate, vehicle-transport_vin-decode, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-recall-by-vin, vehicle-transport_nhtsa-safety-ratings, vehicle-transport_epa-fuel-economy-lookup, vehicle-transport_uk-ved-rate-lookup, vehicle-transport_bts-ontime-lookup.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
